## Decisions already made
- Hypothesis H1 (most likely): the doc is STALE, fixed by `2e585ba4c`; the doc was measured before that fix landed on the measuring worktree. Stage 1 turns that into a permanent Lean-free test; stage 2 gets the Lean verdict.
- If Lean still rejects `absval` after stage 2, the cause is a DIFFERENT error from the one in the doc; the doc's K diagnosis is then closed and a fresh doc `bugs/FORMAL_absval_<new symptom>.md` is not created — the new error goes into this step's Status and work continues here (staged plan below).
